messages:
Maya (CSM): Heads-up: HelioSys renewal is next week. They want to shorten from 12m -> 9m and keep list pricing. Procurement requires vendor code + PO, and prefers EFT over wire (they said bank cutoffs are tight).
Ethan (AE): Thanks. Any promised discounts or credits from prior talks?
Maya (CSM): We verbally offered a one-time implementation credit of $6k to offset onboarding support. They acknowledged it but haven't put it on PO.
Clara (Finance): Need that credit documented on SOW or invoice memo. If they pay via EFT, we need remit info + vendor code up front. EFT timing is typically 3 business days.
Raj (SE): Two infra notes: 1) Helio asked for SOC2 extract and a short data-flow attestation for EU data residency. 2) They also want a dedicated onboarding workshop (3 sessions). Workshop must be scheduled after production access.
Marta (Legal): I can prepare a short addendum for the implementation credit and a data-processing note for EU residency. Who owns the SOC2 excerpt? Ops team or support?
Maya (CSM): I'll upload the SOC2 redacted excerpt from our portal. Also confirm signer roles: they said CFO signs commercial, Head of Security signs data note.
Ethan (AE): Can we keep ARR the same for the shorter term? Need RevOps signoff on 9m pricing and revenue recognition. @Clara any blockers?
Clara (Finance): We're ok with 9m if invoice is issued upfront for the term. If they insist net45 on the PO, we'll need credit approval.
Maya (CSM): Customer prefers Net45 on PO. They asked whether CC fallback is possible if EFT misses the cutoff.
Clara (Finance): Card fallback is OK but we need billing contact and a signed authorization form. Also confirm the vendor code exactly as it will appear on the PO.
Raj (SE): On the technical side, multi-tenant SAML isn't yet GA. We can offer SAML via SSO integration per-tenant, but SE team needs a week to scope. This affects the workshop content.
Marta (Legal): Drafting the credit addendum now. Please provide the exact $6k line and SOW reference. Also need the signer's names for the data attestation.
Maya (CSM): I'll collect names. I'll also ask Helio to include the vendor code and PO number when they send the PO.
ops-bot: SOC2 excerpt uploaded: https://docs.redwood.ai/compliance/soc2-redacted-2025-04.pdf :white_check_mark:
Maya (CSM): Uploaded their requested workshop agenda draft to the customer thread and flagged the CC fallback option.
Ethan (AE): Risk callout: if they put Net45 and EFT drags, we might miss the May onboarding slot. Competitor pilot mentioned in their RFP. Marking renewal risk = high.
Maya (CSM): Escalating to AM lead. Also capturing feedback: they asked for lower-cost embeddings for lightweight agents; logging that for Product.
Clara (Finance): Action items: 1) We need vendor code + remit bank details 2) Decide on upfront vs Net45 + credit approval 3) Card fallback contact + auth form.
Marta (Legal): Action: I'll post the addendum link when ready.
Raj (SE): Action: I'll estimate workshop hours and a 1-week scope for SAML support.
Maya (CSM): I'll follow up with Helio today and request PO + signer names. Will update thread as soon as I hear back.
_meta: generated by dataset gen - renewal execution: vendor code, EFT vs card fallback, implementation credit addendum, SOC2 excerpt, onboarding workshop scheduling
